OPERATOR INSTRUCTION, 2026-09-21, quoted: "Yes, move forward on the cut and the seating... let's push forward on the plan... Let me know when I should check the updated work plan page on the GitHub pages site so that I can see how we're following the work." The operator asked to be told when to LOOK, which means they merge. Independently, this session's standing instruction is to open the PR as a DRAFT. 

Two further reasons a human reads this one rather than letting it self-land, both about blast radius rather than tier. (1) IT REWRITES THE FILE EVERY SESSION READS FIRST. CLAUDE.md goes 547 KB -> 16.5 KB, so a mistake here is inherited by every session after it, silently, and is not the kind of thing a re-read catches. (2) IT EDITS THE GUARD HARNESS. `scripts/ci/run_guards.py` loses 41 entries (111 -> 71) and gains one, so the set of things CI checks changes in the same PR that changes what CI is checking against. That is exactly the shape that wants a second pair of eyes, and no hold_reason names it, so it is said here.
why:
THE 2026-09-21 OPERATING RESET. Operator-directed: the manager-session model of 2026-09-01 'doesn't seem to be working so well... mostly wasting a lot of tokens without producing a lot of results'. Plan of record: docs/plans/OPERATING-PLAN-2026-09-21.md; the 18 items it names are seeded as rows in docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json, which is now the one register.

MEASURED, and every figure carries its population. (a) Real money, /api/bot/performance realMoney all-window on 2026-09-21: n=431, 27.1% win, expectancyR -0.3231, profitFactor 0.68; `vwap` is 318 of those 431 trades at -0.4586R. (b) comms/strategy_reviews/2026-09-20/INDEX.json: 52 legs graded, 71 closes in the window against a min_closed_for_action floor of 20, actionable 0, and its own days_to_grade_all_reachable_point 140.0 with unbounded_no_closes 23 -- the review is correct and structurally incapable of emitting a decision. (c) Over 30 days: 1,005 commits to docs/claude/work/ and 697 to one backlog file, against 141 to the whole of src/ and 9 to config/strategies.yaml. (d) 117 research dispositions, ONE ever marked `actioned`, none since 2026-08-31, against 404 research memos.

WHAT LANDS. CLAUDE.md cut 547 KB -> 16.5 KB (~136K -> ~4.1K tokens); the generated SESSION-BRIEF block was 39.4% of it and is deleted with its generator. Reference material moved VERBATIM to docs/reference/ (six files, sed slices of the original) and the pre-cut file is byte-exact at docs/archive/2026-09-21-operating-reset/CLAUDE.md.pre-cut. The manager contract is one page at .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md. The eight-register operating model is archived: work store (210 objects), OPEN-ITEMS.json, four review backlogs (951 open rows), SESSIONS.json, MANAGER-LEASE.json, MERGE-QUEUE.json, DUE.*, READOUT.md, CONSTRAINT.json, PROBES.json and the coordination board. 12 governance crons are commented out (schedules, not workflows -- workflow_dispatch still works and re-arming is one uncomment). 10 process skills retired. 41 governance guard entries removed from run_guards.py.

WHAT DELIBERATELY DID NOT HAPPEN, because the honest scope is narrower than the tidiest one. The 67 guard SCRIPTS behind the removed entries are NOT deleted: 30+ live files (src/web/api/routers/work.py, src/utils/work_facts.py, tests/, workflows, the commit-to-main action) still name those paths, and deleting them would break working code to tidy a register. They are unreachable from run_guards.py and listed in scripts/ci/guard_selftest_exemptions.json with that reason, dated and tracked to A5.

THREE CONTROLS WERE SAVED RATHER THAN SWEPT UP, which is the part most likely to be got wrong by a wholesale removal. (1) soak-doctrine-exceptions.json and impossibility-claim-baseline.json were RESTORED from the archive -- they guard real code, not the operating model. (2) The soak-doctrine exception was RE-POINTED at checklist item B4 rather than dropped; B4 carries the same finding, and an exception naming a row that does not exist is how a real finding gets silenced (that ledger's own _doc says so). (3) `artifact-validity-guard`, `recurrence-ledger-guard` and `due-list-guard` were grab-bags carrying 18 unrelated research/ops self-tests; those steps are re-added verbatim as `research-tooling-selftests`, each verified passing on the day of the move. Losing them would have been the 'a guard stops looking because the text moved' failure run_guards.py's own header warns about -- the same reason check_canonical_doc_coherence.py's CLAUDE_MD constant was RE-POINTED at docs/reference/env-vars.md instead of having its baseline lowered (18 claimed, floor 18, unchanged).

ONE RATCHET IS LOWERED AND IT IS SAID OUT LOUD: guard-selftest-coverage's COVERAGE_FLOOR 67 -> 44, which that guard's own message permits when guards are removed ('lower COVERAGE_FLOOR in the same commit and say which guard went'). The covered RATIO did not collapse -- 44/94 = 46.8% against 67/134 = 50.0% before. Nothing lost a self-test; the population shrank.

NO ORDER PATH, no strategy config, no risk cap, no account mode, no src/ runtime change. Tier 1. Plan items A6, B1-B4, C1-C5 and D1-D3 are NOT in this diff -- they are queued rows, and A6 (pulling two negative-OOS legs off alpaca_live) is Tier-3 and explicitly waiting on the operator.
